items.title: Amazon (AMZN) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump As AWS AI Demand Lifts Analyst Views
items.summary: Analysts have been nudging up price targets for Amazon.com, with some research now clustering in the US$320 to US$365 range. Much of this shift is tied to AI driven demand in Amazon Web Services, a growing AI and cloud backlog, and updated views on how capital expenditure intensive infrastructure could support future returns, even as some analysts stay cautious on spending and competition.
